title: Bix Maquette
content: This maquette of the Protoceratops named Bix in Dinotopia was sculpted byJim Henson’s Creature Shop. The sculpt is about 36 inches long, cast in resin from a clay original.It has wonderfully expressive glass eyes.The Henson sculptors created it as a proof of concept for how they would develop the character in animatronic form, and the original has appeared in several museum exhibitions.
